surface: `.github/workflows/label-check.yml`, template payload `label-check.yml`, repo `labels.yml`, template payload `ci.yml` PR label gate
summary: Label-check accepts optional `tier:T0` through `tier:T3` on issues and PRs (at most one, never required), independent of issue/PR type and `risk:*` labels (#1328).
migration_impact: Merge updated label-check and PR label gate scripts from plate-core so agent-crew tier metadata no longer fails CI when present.
migration_guidance: Sync `.github/workflows/label-check.yml` and the PR label gate (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` labels job in the template; `.github/workflows/labels.yml` in plate-core) from upstream.
Optional: add `tier:T0`..`tier:T3` to `.github/labels.yml` when you adopt crew routing labels.
agent_notes: Tier labels are optional metadata; zero or one valid tier label is allowed alongside required type labels and optional risk/area labels.
